estimator: episode-cluster bootstrap (taniteval/ci.py stat_cluster_bootstrap / paired_stat_cluster_bootstrap), B 2000, seed 0, over EPISODES -- 'another draw of EPISODES' only; ONE training seed (refcv8); the map head is deterministic given the frames. IoU = pooled counts; recall = pooled window mean (windows with >= 20 GT edge cells).
tier: perception instrument, map head vs SAM3 GT raster, label level (T0); not a planning or driving metric

K_constP_reads_prevalence.note: all-positive map: IoU = class prevalence (independent calc from OWN's class histograms); a constant map has NO boundary, so boundary recall is exactly 0; an all-positive edge candidate has recall 1 and precision = the edge-neighbourhood prevalence

K_deranged_donor_lower_than_own.note: FLAG only, not a VOID condition: a row that is not separated means window-specificity is unproven for that row

REPRO_H-R9-MAPEDGE-1_own_protocol_on_DEV.note: DEV is ~half of eval139 (70 of 139 episodes): a consistency check, not an equality; the exact all-windows reproduction needs the HOLD rasters, which stay unread.
